lines.text: A fax arrives. Someone prints it, scans it, files it. The A1c from the cardiology consult never reaches the diabetes plan. Everyone did their job, and the information is still gone.
Stream Inlet reads every page that arrives, by fax or upload, and proposes the patient. A person confirms.
Then the clinical content lands where it belongs. One discharge summary, three problems, three excerpts.
Every fact is one click from the sentence it came from, and nothing is filed without a human decision.
Keep your fax number. See Inlet on your own documents.
lines.say: Keep your fax number. See Inlet on your own documents.

_note: 'text' is what the captions show; 'say', when present, is what the narrator speaks. Re-run `npm run narrate` after editing either.
